product.description: Servitoarea respectabilei familii Bantry, prieteni ai lui Miss Marple, descoperă în biblioteca acesteia cadavrul unei tinere foarte machiate, într-o ținută de seară cam vulgară. Cine e fata? Cum a ajuns acolo? Și care este legătura cu o altă fată moartă, descopertiă într-o mașină incendiată? Poliția nu are nicio idee, iar bârfele pe seama colonelului Bantry încep să se răspândească în St Mary Mead. Miss Marple se consideră obligată să intervină pentru a apăra reputația prietenilor săi.   AGATHA CHRISTIE este cunoscută în întreaga lume drept „Regina Crimei“. Hercule Poirot, cel mai renumit detectiv după Sherlock Holmes, a fost creat pentru primul roman al Agathei Christie, Misterioasa afacere de la Styles. Poirot și Miss Marple au devenit faimoși la nivel mondial și au făcut subiectul l multor filme realizate pentru marele și micul ecran.   CEL MAI VÂNDUT SCRIITOR AL TUTUROR TIMPURILOR PESTE 2 MILIARDE DE EXEMPLARE VÂNDUTE CĂRȚI TRADUSE ÎN PESTE 100 DE LIMBI   www.agathachristie.com

# The Corpse in the Library: A Classic Mystery by Agatha Christie

Discover one of Miss Marple's most captivating adventures with *Cadavrul din biblioteca* (The Corpse in the Library). This gripping crime novel plunges readers into the intimate world of St Mary Mead, where secrets lie hidden behind respectable facades. If you love classic whodunit mysteries and brilliant detective work, this Agatha Christie title is a must-read addition to your collection.

## The Mystery Unfolds: A Web of Deception

The story centers around the seemingly perfect Bantry family, friends of Miss Marple. Their tranquility is shattered when they discover the body of a young womanâa figure described as remarkably beautiful and dressed in rather vulgar evening wearâstashed within the family's library.

But the mystery deepens:
*   Who was this deceased girl?
*   How did she end up there?
*   What connects her death to another mystery involving a girl found in an incinerated car?

As official police efforts falter, gossip begins circulating around Colonel Bantry within St Mary Mead. Miss Marple finds herself compelled to intervene, dedicating herself to protecting the reputation of her dear friends and unraveling the deadly truth before it's too late. This novel showcases Agatha Christieâs masterful ability to weave together suspense, character drama, and an ingenious puzzle that keeps the reader guessing until the final page.

## About Agatha Christie: The Queen of Crime

Agatha Christie remains a literary phenomenon, known globally as "The Queen of Crime." Her enduring appeal lies in her meticulously crafted plots and memorable characters. While she created icons like Hercule Poirot and showcased Miss Marple's brilliance firsthand, her work continues to captivate readers worldwide. With over two billion copies sold across more than 100 languages, Christieâs legacy defines the genre of mystery fiction.

Whether you prefer following the deductions of a brilliant detective or witnessing the quiet wisdom of Miss Marple, *The Corpse in the Library* offers an unmatched reading experience into classic crime literature.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book suitable for mystery genre fans?**
Absolutely. *The Corpse in the Library* is a quintessential, complex whodunit that features classic elements of detective fiction and suspense, making it ideal for any fan of Agatha Christie's work.

**Do I need prior knowledge of Miss Marple to read this?**
No. While Miss Marple is a beloved character, this book stands alone as a complete mystery narrative, allowing you to jump right into the action!
